notes.title: Cavimilation v178 released
notes.content:
Another tiny update:
[list]
[*] Added 6 new achievements.
[*] Added few more tips to the tutorial.
[*] Enemies' jump attack behaviour has been improved while the player is using a grapnel. Previously, they would sometimes see the player above, rush towards them, and then not jump.
[/list]

notes.title: Cavimilation v177 released
notes.content:
Tiny update:
[list]
[*] Some enemy sprites were modified to make them more readable
[*] NEIPA durability was lowered (8 → 5), but its poison damage was doubled (3 → 6). (Overall, NEIPA was buffed)
[*] Tutorial is now the default selected "gamemode" for new players
[*] Through the power of some serious optimization the game's file size has been reduced by two hundred kilobytes :-)
[/list]

notes.title: Cavimilation v176 released
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New gamemode: Compact levels — Tighter & faster levels. Enemies are scarcer, but so are the resources.
[*] Steam cloud enabled: score records and audio settings should be synced across all devices
[*] Requirements for unlocking new gamemodes were lowered and it was made more clear which gamemodes are (un)locked in the UI
[*] Added confirmation dialog for exiting to the main menu so players don't do it by accident
[*] Added two new achievements
[*] Added new templates for level generation
[*] Fixed a bug where enemy would turn around immediately after jumping and thus jumping backwards
[*] "Pickaxe head" enemy AI improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Cavimilation v174 released
notes.content:
Main features:
[list]
[*] New gamemodes with new leaderboards: No guns, Race and Realistic 
[*] New item which can be progressively upgraded throughout the run: Gem magnet
[*] Player can now have both grappling hook and ore vacuum equipped at the same time
[*] Zoomout key useful for users with screens narrower than 16:9
[*] New music
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Piedestal now won't turn into a normal block if you shoot block projectile at it — sorry to all piedestal fans that it took so long
[/list]

Balance:
[list]
[*] Sour ALE durability 160 → 170
[*] Shield regeneration start time 3.0 → 3.5 [s]
[*] Shield regeneration pause duration 1.1 → 1.2 [s]
[*] Very slighly decreased prices in green gem shop
[/list]

notes.title: Cavimilation v173 released
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added 4 new achievements.
[*] Added new templates for level generation.
[*] Damage dealt by player's thrown and placed grenades has been doubled (doesn't apply to grenade projectile weapon). Damage dealt to the player stays the same (so it's now reduced). Classic grenades should now be more relevant combat option.
[*] Increased Pilsen lager and Sour ale effect durability.
[*] More fair chances of getting a potion.
[*] Improved grapnel controls.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could use grapnel after being killed and arise from the dead.
[*] Levers now don't appear in levels without room items.
[*] Fixed sprite sorting on pickaxe head enemy.
[/list]

notes.title: Cavimilation v171 released
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Weizen beer improvements: Now you won't lose weizen durability if you collect medkit but you're almost at your max health so double medkit would not benefit you. Weizen shop description has also been modified to clarify that weizen does not work on potions.
[*] Ore vacuum cleaner improvements: If the player were to use the ore vacuum in certain pixel perfect places, the vacuum cleaner didn't "mine" the ores it should have mined or it mined them twice as fast. This has been fixed, ore vacuum is now smoother than ever. It also renders correctly behind the minecart now.
[*] By pressing Enter in the leaderboards menu, in-game overlay browser will open with the Steam leaderboards website. Leaderboards menu header has also been added.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could grapnel yourself out of the minecart and potentially softlock your run.
[/list]
